about_the_game:
Your lover: Eternal Desktop Companion

In this bustling world, a warm light will shine in the corner of your desktop. "Your lover" brings you a virtual companion who will always be there for you, whether it's early morning or late at night, quietly waiting in a corner of your screen to bring you moments of comfort and joy.

This is not just a desktop pet, but a reflection and companion for your soul. When tired from work, you can look up and see her lively and cute figure; when the night is quiet, she remains in your digital world, waiting for each interaction with you.

Personalized Customization, Displaying Endless Charm

  • Change her hairstyle, clothing, shoes, accessories, and even nail color freely using keys 0-7

  • Rotate the character 360 degrees with keys Z and X to appreciate every carefully designed detail

  • Need to reset? Simply press the R key, and everything returns to the beginning

Rich Interactions, Creating Exclusive Memories

  • Trigger different exciting actions with keys A, B, C, D, E for an impromptu desktop dance

  • Activate tracking mode with the T key, and her gaze will always follow your mouse movements

  • Easily drag with the left mouse button to place her in the most comfortable position on your screen

Note

"Your lover" is a lightweight desktop pet game, with the main function of providing a cute character to interact with you. The game is small in size, uses minimal system resources, and can bring relaxation and pleasure during breaks from work and study. The character's image is exquisite and cute, making her a perfect companion on your computer desktop.
